pages.brief: A cut-away view of a busy ant nest tunnelled into the ground near the log pile.
Several tiny ants shown beside a single leaf for scale.
One small ant tugging a piece of leaf many times its own size.
A line of ants moving quickly across a log.
Two ants digging busily at a patch of soft mud near the log pile.
Close view of one ant showing its six legs clearly.
Nell the bee watching a single ant crossing a log.
Nell the bee leaning in close, watching the ant carefully.
Nell the bee smiling as a line of ants marches past the log pile.
